title: folder browser first-frame thumbnails
description:
The folder import browser's grid cells showed a generic PlayArrow
glyph; the owner asked (2026-11-15) that even NOT-yet-imported
videos show their real thumbnail. The cells now render frame 0.

FolderVideoCell gains the preview slot: produceState keyed on the
document uri (the FileListRow decode precedent) starts from the
persisted folder-namespace PNG; when missing it runs ONE bounded
generation through the caller's pass, re-reads the store, and
decodes off the UI thread (BitmapFactory on Dispatchers.IO,
try/catch null). The glyph stays as the loading/failed placeholder
(honest state: a failed generation retries on the next open);
ContentScale.Crop fills the 1:1 tile. The LAZY grid is the queue
bound - only composed cells (visible window + prefetch) ever
generate, produceState cancellation drops the ones scrolled away,
so a fast scroll through a 100+ video folder never queues the
folder
changed: data: folder preview store namespace + generation pass
ui: real first-frame thumbnails in folder browser
